faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Didn't find your answer? Email us or message support.

why.q: Why is a smart conversation better than a regular form?
why.a: Long forms are tiring and most people abandon them. Monno talks with your users, adapts its questions to earlier answers, and politely asks for more detail when an answer is vague. That means more answers, and more precise ones.

dashboard.q: What does the dashboard show me?
dashboard.a: Instead of reading hundreds of long responses, you get a summary: your users' biggest problems, how they feel about the product overall, and — most importantly — practical suggestions for fixing those problems. It turns data into decisions.

coding.q: Do I need to know how to code?
coding.a: Not at all. You write the goal of your survey and get a link. Put that link in an email, on social media or inside your product. There is no code to install and nothing technical to configure.

setupTime.q: How long does it take to set up a survey?
setupTime.a: Less than 5 minutes. Tell us what you want to learn and who your audience is. The AI does the rest and designs the questions.

pricing.a: We offer several plans, from free to get started up to professional plans for large teams. Pricing combines a subscription with pay-as-you-go, so you only pay for the analyses you actually run.

privacy.a: Yes — security and privacy are our priority. We only collect the information your analysis needs. You own all of the data and can delete or export it whenever you like.

reliability.q: How reliable is the AI analysis?
reliability.a: We use the world's most advanced language models to understand exactly what users mean. Each conclusion also shows a confidence score and the number of responses that support it.

planChange.q: What happens if I want to change my plan?
planChange.a: You can upgrade or downgrade at any time. The system prorates charges by the days remaining, so you never lose what you paid.
